definitions.explanation: Electromagnetic radiation used for communication, broadcasting, and other technological applications.
In casual usage, refers to the quality of wireless signal reception.

examples.japanese: ここは{電波|でんぱ}が{悪|わる}い。
{電波|でんぱ}で{情報|じょうほう}を{送信|そうしん}する。
examples.english: Information is transmitted via radio waves.

examples.japanese: {電波|でんぱ}{時計|どけい}は{正確|せいかく}だ。

notes:
TECHNICAL USE:
- {電波|でんぱ}を{発信|はっしん}する (to transmit radio waves)
- {電波|でんぱ}を{受信|じゅしん}する (to receive radio waves)
- {電波|でんぱ}{障害|しょうがい} (radio interference)
- {電波|でんぱ}{法|ほう} (Radio Law)

EVERYDAY USE:
- {電波|でんぱ}が{悪|わる}い (poor signal/reception)
- {電波|でんぱ}が{入|はい}らない (no signal)
- {電波|でんぱ}{時計|どけい} (radio-controlled clock)

SLANG (dated): {電波|でんぱ}系 was used to describe someone who seems disconnected from reality or has strange ideas (not recommended to use).

SCIENCE: {電波|でんぱ} is part of the electromagnetic spectrum, with frequencies lower than infrared.
